**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Sturdy
solution: The correct answer is 'Delicate.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let us see the **meaning **of Sturdy: • Sturdy: strong and healthy; that will not break easily. (हृष्‍ट-पुष्‍ट और स्‍वस्‍थ; जल्‍दी न टूटने वाला, मज़बूत, दृढ़) • Let us see the **meanings **of the given options: • Delicate: **easy to damage or break. (नाज़ुक, आसानी से टूट जाने वाला) • **Dragging: **extremely tired or slow. (अत्यधिक थका हुआ या धीमा) • **Tiny: **very small. (बहुत छोटा; नन्‍हा) • **Drab: **not interesting or attractive. (अनाकर्षक, फीका, बेचमक, नीरस) • From the meanings of the given words, we can say that word** "Delicate" **is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word **"Sturdy."** • Hence, the correct answer is Option 1. 40:Tcf4, The correct answer is **"Who"**.
